what: Register and turn on the new blaze lint `blaze::fiber_boundary` (crates/blaze-lints/src/blaze/fiber.rs, docs/v2/plan/lanes/may-suspend/fiber-boundary.md). (1) crates/blaze-lint-defs/src/lints.rs: append to the `BLAZE` table `l("blaze::fiber_boundary", Allow, "detects a path to blaze's fibers or corosensei outside `blaze_graph::sched`")` so `#[deny(blaze::fiber_boundary)]` is not an unknown lint. (2) root Cargo.toml: add a `[workspace.lints.blaze]` table with `fiber_boundary = "deny"` (none exists yet; blaze-lints reads `[lints.blaze]` in crates/blaze-lints/src/manifest.rs and level.rs, so members with `[lints] workspace = true` pick it up). Land (2) only after lane sched moves crates/blaze-graph/src/pump.rs, crates/blaze-query/src/lib.rs and crates/blaze-query/src/db.rs onto sched:: re-exports, or the tree fails its own lint.
